newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Caltex sells 20,000/T fuel oil at +$1.50 to SPC.
newsitem.headline: Caltex sells 20,000/T fuel oil at +$1.50 to SPC.

text.p: Caltex Singapore has sold by tender 20,000 tonnes of 380-cst grade fuel oil at a premium of $1.50 per tonne to spot Singapore quotes to Singapore Petroleum Co, industry sources said on Friday.
The cargo was awarded on an inter-tank transfer basis for April 26-28 lifting, the sources said.
Caltex did not award a second tender to sell 30,000 tonnes of 380-cst grade and 10,000 tonnes of 180-cst fuel oil also on an inter-tank-transfer basis on April 15.
Traders said the offer was probably too prompt to attract buyers.
